sources.citation: Lama, Ziwo Qiu-Fuyuan. 2012. Subgrouping of Nisoic (Yi) Languages: a study from the perspectives of shared innovation and phylogenetic estimation. PhD dissertation, University of Texas at Arlington. Azhe profile p. 78; tone inventory table; Azhe data from YYFC 1983 (Zhongzhai village, Wushan township, Mile).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: online with a university library login
sources.note: 'The Azhe has 38 initials, 16 vowels (16 monophthongs and one diphthong), 4 tones (/55/, /33/, /22/, and /21/) (cf. YYFC 1983).' The word 'stress' does not occur anywhere in the dissertation text (a full-text search for stress/accent count 0).

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2007. Change Request 2007-079: rename 'Yi, Azhe' -> 'Azhe' (submitted with Pelkey's rationale; sources Bradley & Bradley 2002, Gerner 2002, Pelkey 2005).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Naming change only; no linguistic description.

sources.citation: Wikipedia (en) 'Azhe language' and 'Gepo language'; Wikipedia (zh) 阿哲语 (redirects to 彝语东南部方言).
sources.note: Azhe page: Wang 2003 dialect division (五山/江边/曲江), autonym a21dʐɛ22pho21, no phonology beyond tone digits. Gepo page confirms Xiaobai Yi/Gupo = gepo1234. No stress statement.

sources.note: The only dedicated phonology article on Azhe by the native-speaker describer; 3 pages on the segments and tones of the Wushan variety, the natural place for any remark on 重音/轻声. Full text exists as a 374 kB PDF on NCPSSD (id 1002210592) behind a free-registration login; also on CNKI.

sources.citation: Pu Lichun 普丽春 & Wang Chengyou 王成有. 2007. 小白彝语概况 [A sketch of Xiaobai Yi]. Minzu Yuwen 2007(1): 63-80. (Glottolog ref 576205, filed under azhe1235.)
sources.tag: not read: abstract or record only

sources.note: NCPSSD abstract only: '小白彝语是彝语东南部方言一种次方言，主要分布在云南省的弥勒、泸西、嵩明、寻甸、沾益、罗平、师宗、路南、陆良、宜良、富源、邱北、禄劝、会泽、彝良、鹤庆等市县，使用者约10万余人'. This distribution and Wang 2003's 古泼话研究 chapter (autonym ko55 pho21, other-names 白彝/甘彝/小白彝, 6 tones) show it describes Gepo/Gupo (gepo1234, ISO ygp), not Azhe. Full text login-gated; body unread.
